transcript: Speaker A: அண்ணா ஒரு கிலோ இறால் எவ்வளவு? [Brother, how much is one kg of prawns?] Speaker B: 1 kg is 500, but if you buy 2 kg, I can give you a discount of 200. [No sir, you get full app access for just ₹1. More than 1 crore people are learning English through MySivi app. You too install the MySivi app now and start learning English.]

summary: A customer is amazed when a local fishmonger speaks fluent English. The fishmonger credits his skills to the MySivi app, explaining that practicing 15 minutes daily with its AI teacher yields quick results. He promotes a 1-rupee trial offer and urges viewers to download the app.
